note: Open items carried from the overhaul, checked 2026-11-13. Status is passing or failing; cmd decides it (run from repo root, exit 0 = passing). Passing items remain in the file as verification history; each open item has its current external blocker.

items.what: Sourced walkthrough stops for BnF street panoramas x03 and x05
items.blocker: None. Panoramax coordinates place x03 near rue Vivienne and rue des Petits-Champs, and x05 near rue Vivienne and rue Colbert. Both stops cite the BnF's own Richelieu history.
items.cmd: jq -e '.bnf.nodes | (.x03|length) > 0 and (.x05|length) > 0' data/hotspots.json

items.what: IIIF manifest for the four Dunhuang holders other than the British Library (BnF, National Library of China, Institute of Oriental Manuscripts, Tokyo National Museum)
items.blocker: BnF and National Library of China now have verified IDP manifests. Two Institute of Oriental Manuscripts candidates returned HTTP 404 from data.idp.bl.uk, and no Tokyo National Museum manifest has been verified. Those two holders still need valid manifest URLs from IDP or the holder.
items.cmd: jq -e '[.[] | select(.lib=="dunhuang" and .manifest==null)] | length == 0' data/dispersal.json

items.what: IIIF manifest for the Vatican Library's Corvina
items.blocker: None. The official Corvina programme identifies Vat.lat.3186; its Vatican IIIF v2 manifest is valid and contains 239 canvases. Vat.lat.8541 was rejected because it is the earlier Hungarian Angevin Legendary, not a Corvina.
items.cmd: jq -e '[.[] | select(.lib=="buda" and .holder=="Vatican Library" and .manifest!=null)] | length == 1' data/dispersal.json

items.what: Measured impulse response for at least one listed library, in data/ir.json
items.blocker: None. Mafra is listed (id mafra). Uses the REVERBDATA Mafra Library response, source S1 to position 4 (D. Alarcão, A. Couto Pinto, ESML), from https://reverbdata.ipl.pt/; the site footer states CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, so NonCommercial and ShareAlike apply. Shipped file is the stereo AB pair resampled from 96 kHz to 48 kHz. OpenAIR not retried.
items.cmd: bun scripts/checks/f07-measured-ir.ts

items.what: Gaussian-splat capture for at least one listed library, in data/splats.json
items.blocker: Still no verified Gaussian-splat capture with a named author, reusable licence and anonymous download for a listed library. The State Library Victoria source is now downloadable and shipped as an aligned 5.92 MB photogrammetry mesh under CC BY-NC-SA, but a mesh is not a splat and does not satisfy this item. Close this only with a real licensed splat or a new multi-view capture trained with Brush; do not synthesize splats from a mesh merely to pass the check.
items.cmd: bun scripts/checks/f08-splat-rooms.ts

items.what: Real interior 360 panorama for the Peabody library
items.blocker: Johns Hopkins now offers an official high-resolution Peabody 360 interior tour, linked from the library page and data/tours.json. The official tour does not grant a self-hosting licence, and no licensed equirectangular file has been supplied. Request the media from JHU or make a new capture under its handheld, personal, non-commercial photography policy; do not copy the hosted tour files.
items.cmd: jq -e '[.peabody.nodes[] | select(.real and .kind=="interior")] | length > 0' data/spheres.json

items.what: Real interior view of the Vasconcelos Library at Buenavista (the current panorama shows Biblioteca de México at La Ciudadela, and says so)
items.blocker: Only wide interior is Commons File:Vestibulo Biblioteca Vasconcelos.jpg (ProtoplasmaKid, CC BY-SA 3.0, 12780x2344): a cylindrical vestibule shot, not a 360. Owner call: use it as a flat image or wait for a true 360.
items.cmd: jq -e '[.vasconcelos.nodes[] | select(.real and .kind=="interior")] | length > 0' data/spheres.json

items.what: Real captured interior mesh for at least one listed library
items.blocker: None. State Library Victoria's 65.37 MB source was optimized to a 5.92 MB Draco GLB, aligned to floor level, and exercised in the browser with movement and local decoding. Draft capture by University of Melbourne Digitisation. Sketchfab and the GLB name CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; Zenodo DataCite metadata names 2.0, and that version discrepancy is recorded in data/captures.json rather than hidden.
items.cmd: bun scripts/checks/captured-mesh.ts

items.what: External tours, spatial concordance, architectural phases, and conservation watch have valid source data
items.blocker: None. IIIF v2/v3 parsing is unit-tested, including object-form services and native-width limits. End-to-end tests cover the reading desk, evidence tools, capture registry, and listening points.
items.cmd: bun scripts/checks/connected-features.ts

items.what: Owner listens to the room tour in both voices (browser speech and Better voice) and signs off
items.blocker: Needs human ears. Open any room tour, click Better voice, accept the 96 MB download. Then set listened to today's date.
items.cmd: jq -e '.items[] | select(.id=="audio-listening-test") | .listened != null' todo.json

items.what: Sitemap, robots, and a specific title, canonical and share image on every static and client-rendered page
items.cmd: bun scripts/checks/seo.ts

items.what: Built site stays under the Cloudflare Pages caps (20,000 files, 25 MiB per file) with headroom
items.cmd: bun scripts/checks/deploy-limits.ts

items.what: Every page template has a skip link to its main content, and the two text faces are preloaded
items.cmd: rg -q "class=\"skip\"" dist/index.html && rg -q "class=\"skip\"" dist/read/gita/index.html && rg -q "class=\"skip\"" dist/404.html && rg -q "rel=\"preload\" as=\"font\"" dist/index.html

items.what: CI runs the release gate and every check recorded as passing, on pushes to main and overhaul and on pull requests
items.cmd: rg -q "bun run build" .github/workflows/ci.yml && rg -qF "select(.status==\"passing\")" .github/workflows/ci.yml

items.what: Each build names the service worker runtime cache after its commit, so a deploy replaces cached book parts and chunks
items.cmd: ! rg -q "wl-v4" dist/sw.js && rg -q "const CACHE = .wl-[0-9a-f]{12}." dist/sw.js

items.what: README says how to run and release the site, and that the MIT licence covers the code while each text, photo, scan and recording keeps its own licence
items.cmd: rg -q "The code is MIT" README.md && rg -q "CC BY-NC 4.0" README.md

items.what: Every photo caption offers a ready attribution (title, author, licence deed, Commons source), a copy button and a 1920px download
items.cmd: rg -q 'Use this photo' dist/libraries/admont/index.html && rg -q 'rel="license"' dist/journey/nineveh/index.html && bun test src/site/credit.test.ts

items.what: A /display/ page sets text size, spacing, contrast and motion; every page, Astro and client-rendered, applies the choice before first paint
items.cmd: rg -q 'name="contrast"' dist/display/index.html && rg -q 'wl.display' dist/index.html && rg -q 'wl.display' dist/room/admont/index.html && rg -q 'wl.display' dist/404.html

items.what: /libraries/ offers a Table view: a real table of all libraries with city, country, founding year, status and counts, sortable by any column heading (aria-sort), honouring the same filters, and linkable as /libraries/#table
items.cmd: rg -q 'data-view="table"' dist/libraries/index.html && rg -q 'aria-sort="ascending"' dist/libraries/index.html && [ "$(rg -o '<tr data-q' dist/libraries/index.html | wc -l)" -eq "$(jq length data/libs.json)" ]

items.what: Named shelves of libraries and books kept in this browser: 'Add to a shelf' on every library and book page, a Your shelves section on /shelf/ with remove, delete, a #s= share link, and JSON export and import; shared and imported data is cleaned to same-site paths
items.cmd: bun test src/site/shelves.test.ts && rg -q 'Add to a shelf' dist/libraries/admont/index.html && rg -q 'Add to a shelf' dist/books/abrogans/index.html

items.what: Printed books and texts list free editions elsewhere: the Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks edition we cite, plus Open Library, HathiTrust, Standard Ebooks and Gutenberg full-text searches by title and author
items.cmd: rg -q "id=\"free\"" dist/books/carol/index.html && rg -q "standardebooks.org/ebooks/charles-dickens/a-christmas-carol" dist/books/carol/index.html && rg -q "gutenberg.org/ebooks/8581\"" dist/books/pg-8581/index.html && ! rg -q "id=\"free\"" dist/books/gutenberg-loc/index.html

items.what: Book pages say where the book is now: a lost library's books read From <library>, Now at <present holder> (or Present holder unknown) and link where the rest of the library went; every book links its holder record, its Wikidata item and its IIIF manifest when it has them
items.cmd: rg -q "From <a href=\"/libraries/herculaneum/\"" dist/books/herc-naples/index.html && rg -q "Now at Biblioteca Nazionale" dist/books/herc-naples/index.html && rg -q "/libraries/herculaneum/#dispersal" dist/books/herc-naples/index.html && rg -q "wikidata.org/wiki/Q1105484\" rel" dist/books/wd-q1105484/index.html && rg -q ">IIIF manifest<" dist/books/wd-q1105484/index.html

items.what: /compare/ shows two library halls in one frame with a keyboard and touch swipe divider (a range input), their place, date, holdings, size and status side by side with photo credits, linkable as ?a=&b=; every library page links Compare with another
items.cmd: rg -q "type=\"range\"" dist/compare/index.html && [ "$(rg -o "<option" dist/compare/index.html | wc -l)" -eq "$(( $(jq length data/libs.json) * 2 ))" ] && rg -q "/compare/\\?a=admont" dist/libraries/admont/index.html

items.what: The scan zoom dialog streams IIIF tiles from the holder with OpenSeadragon (drag, wheel, pinch, arrow keys, zoom buttons and Fit), so a page can be read at full resolution; reduced motion turns off the zoom animation
items.cmd: rg -q "\"openseadragon\"" package.json && rg -lq "open-failed" dist/_astro && rg -q "deep-zoom tiles" e2e/scan.spec.ts

items.what: Books are shelved by century, language and author at /books/topics/ and /books/<facet>/<key>/ (topics with two or more books only), each book page links to its topics, and the Books index links the hub
items.blocker: None. The catalogue has no place or printer fields, so those facets wait for data.
items.cmd: bun test src/site/topics.test.ts && rg -q "href=\"/books/language/la/\"" dist/books/topics/index.html && rg -q "href=\"/books/author/charles-dickens/\"" dist/books/carol/index.html && [ -f dist/books/century/3rd-bc/index.html ] && rg -q "/books/topics/" dist/books/index.html

items.what: An author spelled more than one way in the catalogue (Dostoevsky and Dostoyevsky, Nietzsche with and without Wilhelm, Cervantes with and without Saavedra, and others) gets one topic shelf under one name, the combined Grimm entry counts for both brothers, and the four shelf URLs the merge removed redirect to the merged shelf
items.blocker: None. A new spelling in the catalogue needs a line in the alias map in src/site/topics.ts.
items.cmd: bun test src/site/topics.test.ts && [ ! -e dist/books/author/fyodor-dostoyevsky ] && rg -q "More by Fyodor Dostoevsky" dist/books/crime/index.html && rg -q "^/books/author/fyodor-dostoyevsky/ /books/author/fyodor-dostoevsky/ 301$" dist/_redirects
